record.issue_text: findMembers() promise in setupController (admin_group_route.js and group-members.js.es6) is fire-and-forget, so failures (403/404/network errors) are silently swallowed and the UI shows an empty member list with no error indication

adjudication.rationale: In both `admin_group_route.js` and `group-members.js.es6`, `setupController` now calls `model.findMembers();` without returning/awaiting the promise (`afterModel` hooks that returned the promise were removed). `Discourse.Group#findMembers` performs an async `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` and does not attach error handling. Because this promise is no longer part of the route’s transition promise chain, failures (403/404/network) won’t trigger Ember’s route error handling and the `members` property will never be set, leaving the UI to render an empty list with no error indication.
